description: modified eCommerce Shopsoftware versions through 3.3.0 contain a local file inclusion vulnerability. This flaw allows administrators to include arbitrary server files by embedding '../' sequences in content manager file names. Unauthenticated requests to shop_content.php then include these paths, potentially executing embedded PHP code as the web server user.
